LanguageData.AC.BodyOptionsExplanation: Baseliner skin and hair colour options are always available. Chosen options will be used as active genes, while conflicting ones will be dormant.

LanguageData.AC.SleeveCustomizationExplanation: When you press Accept, a sleeve will begin growing in this sleeve gestator. During growth, it will require a constant power connection as well as a neutroamine connection via neutro pipes. When the timer finishes, the sleeve can be extracted and either used straight away or inserted into a sleeve casket.

Just like a regular shield belt, it is susceptible to EMP.\n\nCuirassier belts do not recharge themselves; they need to be manually charged from a power grid, using batteries, rechargers or exposed conduits.

Warning: The stack you are trying to factory reset does not belong to your faction.

LanguageData.AC.NeuralStackEditExplanation: Neural Stacks feature advanced encryption to prevent outside forces from messing with the stored consciousness. Known exploits allow for some data to be edited and rewritten at the cost of stack degradation.

LanguageData.AC.Tutorial: WARNING: The more you edit, the higher the stack degradation will be, causing the stored pawn's consciousness to become more and more unstable. Stack degradation will go away over time after the stack is installed in a body, but this can take years.
